description: Seeded campaign-targeting profile derived from Day 1 events + orders: Day 2 K-Means segment + manual RFM bucket + Day 3 conversion probability + customer value. Seeded campaigns table with rules (target segments, eligible buckets, probability/value thresholds, cost, budget, contact limit).

seed.note: isti seed kao Day 2 (K-Means k=4) i Day 3 (logistic_regression) — reproduktivno

fields.segment: K-Means labela segmenta (segment_0..3; Day 2, k=4, seed 42)
fields.probability: float 0..1, P(kupovina u prediction window-u) iz Day 3 modela (logistic_regression, seed 42)
fields.monetary: float, ukupna vrednost porudžbina (istorijska vrednost korisnika)
fields.recency_days: int, dani od reference do poslednje kupovine (ili aktivnosti)
fields.aov: float, prosečna vrednost porudžbine (0.0 za ne-kupce)
fields.conversion: float 0..1, sesije sa kupovinom / sve sesije
fields.favorite_category: float ili NaN, modus kategorije po product_view

campaign_fields.name: str, naziv kampanje
campaign_fields.target_segments: JSON lista ciljanih K-Means segmenta (prazno = svi)
campaign_fields.eligible_buckets: JSON lista dozvoljenih RFM bucket-a (prazno = svi)
campaign_fields.min_monetary: float, prag istorijske vrednosti (0 = nije aktivan)

reproducibility_note: No wall-clock timestamp is recorded here: the generator is byte-for-byte reproducible, so the sidecar must not change between runs. Regenerate with the same seed to reproduce all files.
